## My request:
Let’s test the ch feasibility boundary and both boundaries together. Freeze the rules, check power and false positives on fresh controls, and keep failures. Voynich stays closed; H/F stay separate. 🐍

items.text: I’ll freeze two separate challenges: one with *ch* availability just above its required rate, and one with both *ch* and *sh* just above theirs. I’ll draw availability masks before screening and check false positives as well as power. Voynich stays closed; H/F stay separate. 🐍

For these two boundary cases, the frozen generator samples availability masks conditional on the desired *ch* and *sh* counts, before drawing *qok* outcomes. That reliably supplies the cases, but it can itself induce an association. The null controls are therefore testing whether the existing rule remains valid after that conditioning—not assuming it does.

## My request:
Let’s test the four-body rule near the feasibility boundary, not just with fully available followers. Freeze it, check power and false positives on fresh controls, and keep failures. Voynich stays closed; H/F stay separate. 🐍

items.text: I’ll test cases where available *sh* followers are only just sufficient for the target rate, while preserving the four-body support structure. The availability masks will be drawn before screening, so we can check whether the feasibility filter inflates false positives. Voynich stays closed; H/F stay separate. 🐍

**The four-body test passes near the binding *sh* feasibility boundary.** 🐍

Only **25–26.8% of matched *sh* followers** were available—just enough for the target rate.

| Fresh control | Result |
|---|---:|
| Matched +15-point effect | **200/200 detected** |
| Low-baseline null | 0/200 flagged |
| High-baseline null | 0/200 flagged |
| Page/line/position nuisance null | 0/200 flagged |

All frozen confidence gates passed. We preserved **276 rejected layouts** and all 800 outcomes.

**Scope:** this tests the *sh* boundary with balanced four-body overlap and artificial blocked followers. The *ch* boundary, both boundaries together, and sparse manuscript-like coverage remain unqualified.

[Report and complete records](</C:/Users/lewis/OneDrive/Documents/ChatGPT/Voynich/sh-qok-feasibility-boundary/report.html>). **Voynich stayed closed; H/F remain separate.**

## My request:
Let’s freeze a four-body generator that reliably supplies near-threshold cases, then test the joint support-and-feasibility rule on fresh controls. Keep failures; Voynich stays closed and H/F stay separate. 🐍

items.text: I’ll freeze a four-body generator designed to supply cases near V = 80, using support and feasibility to select them before drawing *qok* outcomes. Then I’ll test power and false positives on fresh controls. The previous sampling failure stays on record; Voynich stays closed and H/F stay separate. 🐍

The generator is now constructing balanced four-body layouts at V ≈ 82.29, rather than searching for rare matches by rejection sampling. It has supplied the first 100 cases successfully. This is deliberately a favorable overlap test: it checks the rule near the support threshold, but won’t establish that sparse manuscript-like layouts can reach it.

**The frozen four-body generator supplied all 200 cases, and every qualification gate passed.** 🐍

All cases had **V ≈ 82.29**, distributed equally across 12 pages.

| Control | Flags |
|---|---:|
| Matched +15-point effect | **195/200 detected** |
| Low-baseline null | 1/200 |
| High-baseline null | 0/200 |
| Page/line/position nuisance null | 0/200 |

Power’s lower confidence bound was **94.3%**; all false-positive upper bounds stayed below **5%**.

**Scope matters:** these layouts deliberately provide balanced four-body overlap and fully available followers. This resolves the sampling failure for that architecture; it does not qualify sparse layouts or cases near the feasibility boundary.

[Report, frozen rules and all 800 outcomes](</C:/Users/lewis/OneDrive/Documents/ChatGPT/Voynich/sh-qok-four-body-boundary/report.html>). All failures—including five missed positives—remain recorded. **Voynich stayed closed; H/F remain separate.**
